p1: 39 years ago this week, a man in a rubber mask hijacked TV in Chicago. He was never caught.
Sunday night, 1987. The sports news is live on WGN. Then the screen goes black.
A man in a mask appears. Swaying. No voice. Just a loud buzz.
Engineers cut him off. The anchor says: if you're wondering what happened... so am I.
Two hours later, another channel. A Doctor Who rerun.
The picture cuts out. He's back. And this time... you can hear him.
A distorted voice. Laughing. Humming. For about a minute and a half.
Then, on its own... the signal vanished.
The FCC and the FBI investigated.
Nobody was ever identified. Whoever was behind that mask... has never been found.
